{{Quote|Sergeant Harbon told me something about a time like this on Ferton.|A mercenary|<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>}}
'''Harbon''' was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Company/Legends|company]] who once served on [[Ferton]]. Harbon later related an account of events which the sergeant had witnessed on Ferton to a fellow [[Unidentified mercenary (Sergeant Harbon)|mercenary]].<ref name="RPG" />
